name: In Defense of the King's Lands
objectiveText: Kill the Trogg leader, Grawmug , and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler then report back to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.   Grawmug slain  ( 1 )   Gnasher slain  ( 1 )   Brawler slain  ( 1 )

comments.body:
All three of them can be found by going to the cave entrance at 35,83.  Grawmug is at 34,90 in there.

CosmosUI lets you see map coordinates.
35,83 is the entrence to the cave where they all are

Go in the cave, follow it around the bend till you can go 3 different ways.  Take the route on the right, follow that way a bit, go across the enterance of this small creek, up a small hill, and they're right around the corner to the left.  It's a small niche that you could easily miss if you don't pay attention.  

Solo'd it with a 16 NE Warrior just minutes ago.  Was a little bit of a pain, but if you're careful (and have a few pots) you should be fine...

take out Brawler first. he's the one that has the 3 sec stun that will bugger up your healing when you're in a tight spot. it's a resonably easy thing to solo if you're not afraid to blow a potion and maybe some cooldowns if you have 'em
You must complete The Trogg Threat first before you he'll give you the final phase of this quest.
they are in the cave in the mountains past stonesplitter valley the cave is the one with the cooking pot outside and the boss and his 2 guards are on a ledge inside the cave

It might be easy to solo this quest as as mail or leather wearer, but as a mage/cloth wearer, its quite a different story.  Tried soloing this several times as a 22 Mage with fairly good gear.  All 3 named were up.  Sheeped the highest one (he was 17, the other 2 were both 16).  That was about the last cast I got off.  The other 2 agroed and I was constantly getting either stunned or knocked down which very efficiently interupted/canceled my casting.  I do mean constant - during the entire fight I was able to start casting 1 time before I got interruted, otherwise, I was either stunned or laying on my back.  Anyway, a few seconds later, the sheeped mob becomes unsheeped (far far sooner than expected) and also agros.  Fight didn't last very long.  Same results each time I tried this.  Need a group for this or a few more levels (at which point, I'm sure it will go gray on me).  Any cloth wearers at about my level who have successfully done this solo, I'd like to know how (melee types need not reply..lol).  If I could at least take out 1 of em, I could come back and take out the other two, but was completely unable to do even that...the mob I was fighting didn't even get 1/2 way down.
replies: I tried to solo them as a 21 Warlock. It was quite easy. I simply put all my DoT's on one of them, ran a bit, then put DoT's on the other two. The first guy never reached me, the other two succeeded in interrupting my casting, but when they did so, they went after my voidwalker for some reason, giving me the opportunity to cast when the stun was gone. They died quickly and I didn't have to use healthstone or pot.

I solo'd this with ease - mage level 20.

Sheeped Grawmug, hit one of his companions with a fireball. Then Frost Nova'd them, killed the one I had just hit. Re-sheeped Grawmug, killed his other companion while using a Lesser Healing Potion. Re-sheeped Grawmug, used a bandage, then used a fireball on him. Frost Nova'd him and then finished him off. Simple.

comments.body: Take down Brawler first. He will stun you quite often, it makes it easier to kill the others.

Completed this today. If your group tries to take the center room that has the 3 named up top on the overhang, you will agro them and they will run around through the cavern and bring around 6 more adds.

You can get up to their spawn point by turning right after entering the cave. Clear the cavern around them, and pull them to your group. 

They can be taken down by 4-5 players in the 13-16 range safely. A group of 3 or less at that level will be really rough and probably require multiple retries.
replies: WE went right as stated and killed our way to the three named mobs.  It was myself 14 mage and a 17 paladin.  We targeted Grawmug and took him out first then the palidn took one of the guards and I took the other.  He had to heal once during battle and I used a minor health potion and we smoked them.  Its a fairly easy battle with 3 people or more. Was with with us two.

Solo'd this as a 17 Warrior.  I died once taking out one of the body guards, then came back and finished the the other and the boss off with life to spare.
Did this quest solo as a 18 warrior : Killed one, slowed and un-aggro the other two then came back full life to finish the job.

I tried to kill them through AOE yesterday (Blizzard, Frost Nova) and almost managed it (2 were trying to run away) but died. What worked for me:

[ul]
[li]clear out the surrounding area of other troggs[/li]
[li]sheep the highest level of the three bosses (level 17)[/li]
[li]frost nova the other two when they get close to you[/li]
[li]single target (eg frostbolt) Brawler down (he's the most annoying one with stuns and interrupts)[/li]
[li]take a healing pot and/or resheep the 17 and/or run away (this is why you want to clear the surrounding area) to bandage, eat, etc.[/li]
[li]depending on your level/experience, once Brawler is dead you can either take on the other two at the same time or repeat the sheeping process[/li]

[/ul]

Sometimes there's a chest on the ledge they're standing on too. Hope this helps

As a level 16 Rogue, I ganked and shanked my way through the cave. Went the wrong way the first time and had to back track. When I was clearing the room below the boss, somehow they all aggro'd upstairs and came down and killed me. O_O Kept going, a few people showed up and killed the boss before I got there so I kept the hallway clear and waited for the respawn. I took out Brawler first, died, ghostwalk/res'd, killed Grawmug, died, ghostwalk/res'd, killed Gnasher, hearth'd. Had a repair bill of a whooping 3s, oh noes!

Took about an hour but that was mostly due to taking a wrong turn at the beginning and waiting for the respawn. If you have some decent potions (unlike me) you can probably get two of them down before dying. Beware of pats!

Starting from the southwest keep, where the guy gives you the quest. Travel north up the path for a short distance and take your first right. You will come up a gentile ridge into Stonesplinter Valley. If you look to your left you will see a camp of Troggs. Past the camp is path through the hills out of the valley that heads towards the Loch. (Don’t go down there alone under level 14-15.) To the right of this path is the entrance up to another narrow path. (Immediate right, not up further into the valley.) Take this path up and watch your agro. To the right and up the hill you will see a camp fire with some Troggs around it. They are standing right outside a cave. This is the cave where Grawmug is. The cave is a figure 8 shape and he is in the back right corner. 

When I first received this quest at level 17 I was having a spot of trouble finding these guys. I was being silly and did not come to this website. (btw thanks for being here Allakhazam)

The first one died just as the second unfroze, but it was too late for this poor trogg too, he got the fire all in his face. Then I blasted away on the sheep'd 17 with some heals from the priest.

I solo'd this as a 15 lock.  Keep one feared and dotted at all times and have your VW tank the other two.  The one he is attacking should be the one you are attacking.  Repeat with the other non feared mob when the first one dies.  Refear and redot when necessary.  This is one of those times where it pays to be affliction specced as you have 2 instant dots to put on the feared mob.  I had to fear twice and didnt use my healthstone although my VW died at the end.  Oh well....lol.

Also, the mobs are located on a cliff that you can reach by following the right hand path.

I just soloed this as a level 16 mage. Cleared out everything around them, renewed frost armor, and made sure I had a lesser healing potion in my action bar.
I just cast flamestrike on all 3, waited for them to surround me, and started spamming arcane explosion. Downed the potion as soon as I needed it, and kept going. Eventually they all started to run, and I got two with another explosion, but the third snagged another add on his way back. I woulda survived if it wasn't for that, but I managed to kill the third before dying.
Here's to playing a mage like a warrior.
replies:
I soloed as an 18 mage (shouldn't be that difficult, I know).  I died a couple of times, then I tried the strategy given above.  Didn't even need a potion.  One thing I did differently that might make things easier, is before I cast Flamestrike, I targeted Brawler.  After I cast FS, I hit him with a fireball and a fire blast as he was running up to me.  He was mostly dead by the time I started spamming arcane blast, although he WAS able to stun me once.  Took all 3 of them out & didn't even use a potion.  

Nice plan.

Just did this with my dwarf lvl 18 priest. First time I tried it when bad. They have interup and stun moves that hit thru shield. When I did first shield and was almost done casting heal was hit with an interup. So try casting again and was stunned. By the time I came around the shield was gone so I knew I was dead. The second try I was able to take all 3 down. Killed in order of Gnasher(16), Brawler(16) then Gawmug(17). I pulled all 3 both trys. Had cleared the right side path and was behind them. Finished the fight with about 200H and 100M. Started with 550H and 900M. Did not use any pots or buffs beyond Fort and Inner Fire. Just have to take your time. And watch of for the stuns.

And people say priest can't solo. :) And just incase anyone was wondering. Not I am not twinked. In greens with stats as 25,22,39,61,59 and 560ac w/Inner Fire and Fort.

I did this with my level 17 gnome Warlock and my friend, a level 14 dwarf Paladin.  If you clear all the troggs in the area except the three bosses, this gives you room to fear one of them, while you and a friend work on the other two.  Best strategy is to focus on Grawmug first.  Voidwalker can tank the other while the third is running around in fear, though the VW tends to get in the way in tight spaces like caves.  Once Grawmug is down, you should be able to finish the one your VW has weakened, then take down the one you feared originally.
